name: Registered With Email
description: An account in some system is registered with this email address: it is the address on the account's own record, often its login. The source is WILDCARD (omitted), like HELD_BY_HUMAN, so any plugin's type can point here without identity_core depending upward on it; keeping the source to the kind of record described is the drawer's job. An account that keeps the address as a field declares that field as a hotlink to this edge, so the field and the edge cannot disagree. The edge says nothing about who reads the mail and carries no name: the account has its own.
